'''Govera Space''' was the fourth quadrant of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. It provided relatively safe travel routes for visitors of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Little else was known about this area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==Behind the scenes==
Gorvera Space appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online [[roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
